purpose: Final closure checkpoint for Banner Stage 1 after scope freezing, source census, row-grain census, provisional multi-axis taxonomy, relation census, date/recurrence census, asset-reference census, representative fixture validation, and Stage 1 freeze all completed without an unrecorded contradiction.

bannerOccurrence.meaning: One dated Korean schedule/display occurrence row with per-date display order, occurrence taxonomy, optional CardPool source relation, and occurrence-level display asset reference.

bannerSourceCardPool.meaning: ConfigDataCardPoolInfo source identity reached through sourceRecordKey when available.

bannerDefinition.meaning: Recurring/canonical banner concept must be modeled separately from individual dated occurrences; Stage 1 intentionally did not select the final key or production table shape.

acceptedTaxonomy.cpLatestSemantics: CP_RELATED is verified as a non-exclusive context derived only from explicit CardPoolDetailDesc CP-point semantics.

rules: displayImageFile is not canonical bannerId or canonical assetId.
Same verified source may reuse the same display reference across occurrence dates.
Same display reference alone cannot prove source/definition/recurrence identity.
manual-replacement is not equivalent to missing image.
visualType=prefab is not equivalent to missing static website image.

frozenIdentityBoundaries: occurrence identity != canonical banner definition identity
prohibitedInferenceRules: No Hero relation from Korean/Chinese/English name similarity.
No Event relation from display-name equality.
No chronology from CardPool ID, bannerCode, patchCode, slotCode, Hero ID, asset filename, or file order.
No canonical banner identity from recordKey, sourceRecordKey, bannerCode, or displayImageFile alone.
No endDate or duration from the next occurrence date or assumed banner duration.
No recurrence generation from observed fixed/average intervals.
No source or recurrence identity from image equality alone.
No Hero candidate synthesis for source-null manual Wish occurrences.
No forced classification when evidence is insufficient; REVIEW and UNKNOWN remain valid.

items.resolutionTarget: Stage 2 relation/schema work or dedicated Event-ID verification

items.item: Canonical identity policy for source-null manual Wish rows
items.resolutionTarget: Stage 2 manual-definition policy or approved manual ID map

items.item: Exact opening/closing timestamp, timezone, endDate, duration
Canonical asset ownership and content/perceptual duplicate groups
Canonical first-ever release dates outside current 94-row window
Final bannerDefinition/bannerOccurrence production schema and canonical IDs

downstreamRules: Banner Stage 2 must consume data/checkpoints/banner-stage1-8-freeze.v1.json and data/checkpoints/banner-stage1-4-relation-corrections.v1.json before canonical grouping or consumer generation.
Apply the verified 7001 correction so kr-banner:20270331:4 uses effective sourceRecordKey cardpool:265 unless an explicit later repair updates the schedule source itself.
Stage 2 must create canonical bannerDefinition/bannerOccurrence identities without treating bannerCode, sourceRecordKey, recordKey, or asset filename as canonical identity by default.

Stage 2 may normalize the multi-axis taxonomy into production fields/tables, but may not collapse mechanic, lifecycle, pickup cardinality, and non-exclusive context into one ambiguous enum unless the information loss is explicitly avoided.
Hero relations must continue to use exact Hero IDs and preserve PICKUP_HERO versus WISH_CANDIDATE_HERO semantics.
Source-null manual Wish occurrences must remain valid without synthetic CardPool/Hero/recurrence edges until an explicit approved mapping exists.
CP_RELATED remains a context relation; canonical Event ID must not be created from event-name equality.
Observed occurrence dates must be preserved directly; missing exact time/end/duration must remain unknown until independently sourced.
Asset references may support display and provenance but cannot establish canonical banner/source identity; Stage 3 owns hash/diff/candidate matching.
Any later consumer disagreement must be repaired at the canonical relation/schema layer or by regenerating derived outputs, not by page-local guessing.
reopenConditions: A new authoritative game-data snapshot changes CardPool source semantics or invalidates a frozen explicit relation rule.
The verified 7001 correction is contradicted by stronger explicit source evidence.
A future source proves that occurrence/source/definition identity boundaries must change materially.
A future explicit Hero/Wish relation source contradicts the accepted UpHeroList / OptionalUpHeroList / WishHero semantics.
A future explicit CP/Event ID relation proves the Stage 1 text-reference boundary was structurally wrong rather than merely incomplete.
A newly imported Korean schedule changes the Stage 1 population/row-grain contract in a way that cannot be represented as additional occurrence rows under the accepted model.
A Stage 2 schema proposal requires discarding or guessing away an accepted REVIEW/UNKNOWN boundary; in that case reopen the relevant Stage 1 substage instead of silently normalizing it.

closureDecision.reason: Stages 1-0 through 1-8 establish and validate the banner information-unit boundaries, explicit-ID Hero relation families, CP context semantics, occurrence date/recurrence behavior, asset-reference behavior, and mandatory source correction while preserving all known unresolved items as explicit REVIEW/UNKNOWN states. Eight representative fixtures produced zero hard failures and zero new cross-stage contradictions, and the Stage 1-8 freeze records no untracked known conflict or review boundary.

resumePoint.task: Canonical banner identity and production schema design
firstObjectives: Define canonical bannerDefinition and bannerOccurrence IDs/keys.
Define the source-null manual banner identity policy without synthetic joins.
Incorporate the mandatory 7001 correction before production grouping.
Keep Stage 3 asset hash/diff/candidate matching outside Stage 2.
